verdict.rationale: Versioning is evidenced: a live probe shows the Global Catalog MCP server returning a dated API version header, the UCP spec publishes dated releases, and profiles declare the protocol version used in negotiation. The only deprecation evidence is a one-off notice that the old /api/mcp catalog and cart tools were removed, which is not a documented deprecation policy. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (notice periods, support windows, sunset schedule), first-party docs on how versions are selected and how long they are supported, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: a platform profile is a JSON document that describes the protocol version and capabilities the platform supports
The catalog and cart tools on `https://{shop}/api/mcp` were removed. Use the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) instead.
